name: MH04b: Active on ART recovered from Alcohol and Substance use disorder
description:
Number of active ART clients whose alcohol or substance use disorder status was documented as recovered during the reporting quarter.
The patient must have alcohol_and_substance_use_disorder = 'Recovered' during the reporting quarter and satisfy the active-care rule.
creator: 82f18b44-6814-11e8-923f-e9a88dcb533f

sqlTemplate:
SELECT DISTINCT a.patient_id
FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card a
WHERE a.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
  AND a.alcohol_and_substance_use_disorder = 'Recovered'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM mamba_fact_encounter_hiv_art_card x
      WHERE x.patient_id = a.patient_id
        AND (
            x.encounter_date BETWEEN :startDate AND :endDate
            OR x.return_visit_date > :endDate
        )
  );
